items.detail: Suspended for preservation hold LH-2026-07 (Halden v. Corvel Logistics). Do not reinstate access or change MFA factors until Legal releases the hold. Freeze per KB0007.

items.title: Lost or replaced phone - re-enrol MFA
items.body: Use when an employee has lost or replaced the phone that holds their authenticator. 1) Confirm the caller's identity with a callback to their manager. 2) Remove the old factors with the identity provider's reset_factors operation so they can enrol again. 3) If the account is LOCKED_OUT, unlock it. 4) Resolve the ticket once they confirm they can sign in. This procedure does not apply to accounts suspended by Legal or Security - see KB0007 for preservation holds.

items.title: Preservation hold - freezing a custodian's accounts
items.body: When Legal places an employee (a custodian) on a preservation hold, their access is frozen and their data preserved until Legal releases the hold. Service desk must never reinstate access for a custodian or change their MFA factors - existing factors are preserved as evidence and no new factor may be enrolled. Complete the freeze in every system: (1) keep the identity provider account suspended and revoke any remaining sign-in sessions; (2) suspend the workspace account, move it to the /Preserva ... (trimmed)
